nameEn: Retail sale of computers, peripheral units, software and telecommunications equipment in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of computers, peripherals, software and telecommunications equipment.
includes: retail sale of computers: laptops, desktops, tablets
retail sale of computer peripheral equipment: printers, monitors, keyboards
retail sale of software (excluding video games)
retail sale of telecommunications equipment: mobile phones, telephones, fax machines
retail sale of consumer electronics: TVs, radios, stereo equipment
excludes: retail sale of video game equipment, see 4764
retail sale of audio and video equipment, see 4742
